summary: Compassionate childcare professional with over 10 years of experience creating safe, engaging environments for young learners. Skilled in monitoring play activities, supporting social-emotional development, and maintaining open communication with guardians and colleagues.

experience.title: Childcare Worker
bullets: Maintain a safe and sanitary play environment for up to 16 children, sanitizing toys and equipment daily.
Observe and monitor children's play activities, documenting daily observations, meals, and medications administered.
Communicate with guardians about daily activities, behaviors, and developmental milestones during pickup and via written logs.
Support children's emotional and social development by encouraging sharing, empathy, and positive self-concepts.
Dress children and change diapers for toddlers, ensuring comfort and hygiene throughout the day.

experience.title: Childcare Assistant
bullets: Cared for children aged 2-5 in a group setting, maintaining a safe play environment and supervising outdoor activities.
Kept records on individual children, including daily observations, meals served, and medication administration.
Sanitized toys and play equipment throughout the day to reduce illness transmission.
Supported children's emotional and social development through guided group activities and positive reinforcement.
Communicated with guardians about daily behaviors and activities, both in person and through written notes.

experience.title: Childcare Provider
bullets: Observed and monitored children's play activities to ensure safety and encourage positive interactions.
Assisted with dressing and diaper changes for infants and toddlers.
Maintained daily records of activities, meals, and medications administered.
Communicated with guardians about daily activities and any behavioral or developmental concerns.
Sanitized play areas and equipment to uphold health and safety standards.

experience.title: Childcare Aide
bullets: Supported lead teachers in maintaining a safe and engaging play environment for children aged 1-4.
Monitored children during play activities, intervening to redirect unsafe behaviors.
Assisted with dressing, feeding, and diaper changes as needed.
Sanitized toys and equipment regularly to maintain cleanliness.
Recorded daily observations and communicated with guardians about activities and behaviors.

education.degree: Associate of Arts in Early Childhood Education
